name: Nagi
description: Nagi was a planet that was the homeworld of the Nagai species. During the New Republic Era, a number of Nagai were forcefully removed from their homeworld to the planet Gadrilam by other members of the species. Later, the Zantarrk Gang were informed a few hundred more Nagai were en route from Nagi to them.
